signingCertificateStatus: actual APK certificate fingerprint enforced by signed build workflow; physical-device compatibility still requires testing
updatePolicy: Use the stable update center URL in QR codes; do not change the QR for each release.
Show current and available version metadata before the user downloads any APK; never download an APK automatically.
Do not uninstall the installed app or clear its data to solve update errors until package ID, versionCode, and signing certificate compatibility are verified.
Before each publication, verify APK SHA-256, package ID, versionName, versionCode, and the actual APK signing certificate against the expected fingerprint.
Keep 2.4.1 marked expert-review-only; it is not approved for commercial sale.
An in-app update checker must compare the installed versionCode to the published manifest and open the update center only when a newer eligible version is available.
Keep the private keystore and passwords out of the manifest, QR code, public pages, and APK.
note: Public verification metadata only. No private key, keystore password, admin secret, or activation secret belongs here. The stable update center is a verification and download page, not proof of physical-device update compatibility.
